# SCABIES

Scabies is an infestation of the skin by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei. It is transmitted by skin to skin contact. Outbreaks occur in nursing homes, day care centers, and residential institutions. Scabies is highly contagious and meticulous infection control is needed. Treatment is a single application of permethrin cream. Some experts recommend a second application 7-10 days after the first application if the patient is still symptomatic or if live mites are found at that time.

Contact Dermatology or Infectious Diseases for more information.

Treat family members and other close contacts to prevent spread and recurrence.
